newsitem.title: USA: Seattle ballpark cost jumps to $363 mln - report.
newsitem.headline: Seattle ballpark cost jumps to $363 mln - report.

text.p: The cost of the Seattle Mariners ballpark project has jumped to more than $363 million from last year's $285 million estimate, the Seattle Post-Intelligencer reported Friday.
The stadium district's executive director, Ken Johnsen, said the new cost estimate was based on detailed design drawings, the newspaper reported.

Johnsen said the Public Facilities District was able to increase the budget for the project because taxes that state lawmakers designated to finance the stadium were generating more revenue than had been anticipated, the newspaper said.
The new cost estimate has, however, angered some lawmakers, who said the public was led to believe the project would cost less, the newspaper said.
Johnsen was not immediately available to comment on the report.
